exposure: Prior abdominal surgery type (total abdominal hysterectomy/oophorectomy, cesarean delivery, appendectomy, hernia repair)
cohort: Women undergoing abdominally based free tissue transfer for breast reconstruction
finding: Prior abdominal surgeries in women undergoing abdominally based free tissue transfer for breast reconstruction did not significantly increase the risk of major intraoperative complications, thrombotic events, or flap losses.
